description: Attock Petroleum Limited is a Pakistani oil marketing company incorporated in December 1995, supplying fuels, lubricants and LPG through a nationwide network of more than 750 retail outlets and eight bulk oil terminals. Its commercial range covers motor gasoline, high-speed diesel, furnace oil, kerosene, light diesel oil, jet fuel, naphtha, solvents and bitumen, sold to industry, power producers, agriculture and government customers. Aviation refuelling at Islamabad International Airport is run through a joint venture with Pakistan State Oil, and the company has also set up electric-vehicle charging stations in Islamabad.

products.name: Premier Motor Gasoline
products.summary: Petrol supplied through APL's multi-fuel retail outlets and to commercial and industrial customers.

products.name: High Speed Diesel
products.summary: Diesel for vehicles, generators and industrial users, including cement plants.

products.name: Furnace fuel oil
products.summary: Industrial fuel for power generation, boilers, furnaces and bunkering; a residual high-viscosity grade is produced for power plants.

products.name: Jet fuel
products.summary: Jet A and Jet A-1 aviation fuel; refuelling at Islamabad International Airport operates through a joint venture with Pakistan State Oil.

products.name: Lubricants
products.summary: Attock-branded engine oils and industrial lubricants, covering automotive and industrial requirements.

products.name: LPG
products.summary: Liquefied petroleum gas sold by the company; APL also runs an LPG distributorship programme.
